Episode 246: The Battle for the Mitra Desert (13)
'Lady Elona...'
Jin gritted his teeth, recalling her corrupted form with the holy crown.
After meeting Kelliac and donning the crown, she had killed countless people. Even if she were to regain her old self, those deeds could not be undone.
"...I decline the contract."
Shuri made a threatening sound at Masalrun and then withdrew into her gem. Masalrun shrugged as if surprised.
[I don't understand... But I can't force you. I respect your decision. However, if you change your mind, come find Masalrun again. I'll go torment the Red Plutonian in the meantime.]
Masalrun began to fly away. Jin stood still for a while, waiting for Elona to approach.
The rumbling slowly subsided.
As Elona approached, making no effort to hide her immense aura, the Red Plutonian seemed to wait and see.
The battlefield gradually quieted.
Soon, beyond the Red Plutonian waves and the thick sandstorm, the silhouette of Elona began to appear. Jin could even hear her footsteps.
Thump, thump, thump.

Now, instead of the white hair of Ziffle, her golden hair, like the sun, shone brightly even in the darkness of the battlefield. A faint noise, like the friction of metal, emanated from the floating holy crown above her head.
"It's been a while, Lady Elona."
Jin met Elona's gaze.
Her typically clear and bright eyes were nowhere to be seen. Elona's eyes seemed filled with complex, shimmering crystals, reminiscent of opals.
"Jin Runkandel."
Stopping about ten steps away, Elona halted her advance.
A moment of silence passed. Jin recalled the changed appearance of the woman before him and the old image he knew. Upon seeing him, Elona felt a surge of indescribable emotion.
But it wasn't overwhelmingly strong.
"Why have you come to the desert?"
"To destroy the passage that connects to Laprarosa."
"You're as straightforward as ever."
"There's no need to hide it."
"In that case, I'll be honest too. Seeing you changed because of that so-called holy crown complicates my feelings."
Elona didn't respond but waited for Jin's next words.

"Looking back, you've been a complex entity to me from the very beginning. I truly became aware of your existence when I was searching for the tombs of our clan's founder, Temar Runkandel. Some records depicted you as a monster... a slaughterer, while others hinted at your regret for the past."
"What are you trying to say?"

"When you broke the long-standing seal of the Secret Palace and came out into the world, my friend was in a state of corruption, much like you are now. Not by his own will, but due to the mistakes and schemes of others. I'm talking about Beradin Ziffle. And Lady, I've heard that you cared deeply for that misguided fellow."
At that, Elona recalled the voice of Veradin from hell. The voice that cried out, begging her not to forget.
She still hadn't posed questions about him to the Tower of Tales.

"A thousand years ago, and until then, our relationship was clearly that of enemies. However, when I fought against Zito, the real Lady Elona I saw didn't match any record or information. You just seemed... like someone who needed light."
"...Light?"
"Like a beacon one can follow. A guide away from the horrendous things one doesn't want. That's probably why you cherished and loved Beradin."
With a slight chuckle, Elona broke into a smile.

"If that were true, I must've been a comical entity back then. If I really didn't want those horrendous things, I shouldn't have done them. I shouldn't rely on abstract concepts like light or beacons."
"You're right. But humans aren't perfect beings. Everyone has times when life gets tough."
"In that case, one could choose death."
"That's not always possible. Take this Ruby Beast inside this. It's cursed to not be able to do so."
Jin showed the Ruby as he spoke.
"I don't have such a curse."
"Even if it's not magic or power, a certain fate can also be called a curse. Is that artifact, the holy crown, the problem? You've become much narrower than I remember."
"Perhaps. The holy crown is far from reason and rationale. It's designed to obey only the commands of the first entity it recognizes."
"And knowing that, you still continue to wear that dreadful crown?"
"I see no reason to take it off."
"If you were human, naturally..."
"I am not a human, Jin Runkandel. It seems you classify me as a human based on my appearance. So, pushing human standards onto me is pointless. You and I, our consciousness itself is different."
"Eh? You're not a human?"
"You mean... not a human?"
Belize and Linpa, who were silently listening, interjected.
Hearing their voices, Elona recalled the purpose of her visit to this wasteland.
"It seems we've wasted a lot of time on useless talk. Are you the Plutonians who escaped the passage?"
"Hold on, hold on! Before we fight, satisfy our curiosity. Elona Ziffle, if not a human, what are you?"
"Right... What are you?"
"A god? That's not it, right? Before you wore that crown, you had free will and emotions, didn't you? It seems you still possess those two elements."
Elona took a moment to choose her words.
But she couldn't find any. She couldn't classify herself in any category. She was no longer a tree, so she couldn't call herself that, and she was never a human to begin with.
'If I had to define... perhaps a biological weapon...'
Elona summoned her power without voicing that thought.
Within 3 seconds, the entire battlefield began to shake with surging power. Massive structures formed of magic, as large as mountains, were already rising in dozens.
The pressure alone necessitated the formation of protective barriers. The Red Plutonian’s airborne fortress and fleet, located at a distance, also formed protective barriers.
'I felt this in hell, but she's definitely become much stronger than before...'
Even before wearing the Holy Crown, Elona was already transcendental.

But now, Elona clearly possessed a might beyond that, like Siron who had overcome his demonic nature. This was despite the side effects of a previous corruption seal and the mismatch with the Holy Crown.
"Wow, she can't answer!"
"If you really want an answer, just consider me a biological weapon."
"Ha! Fine, even if you're a biological weapon. I cherish my greatsword like a brother... Linpa here feels the same about his weapon."
"What?"
"Even an inanimate weapon can be considered family to someone. All the more for a biological weapon like you."
"What nonsense are you spouting..."

"Our brother-in-arms, Beradin Ziffle, told us before we came here. He said you are precious family, so we shouldn't hurt you too much. Looking at it now, we should've asked Beradin to tell your family to be gentler. Oh, that Betty guy who talked with us back then said he was originally a biological weapon, right? Linpa, brother."
"Yes... That's right."

"Then what else matters? Elona Ziffle. You'll just eventually be rescued by Jin's group and us. Until then, live as you please. You'll have to pay for the sins you've committed so far eventually, but even then, Beradin won't let you go."
"In my heart... there's... a place I like... Beradin. Once a brother, always a brother... family is family... friends are friends."
Whoosh-!
From the cubes floating behind Elona, spears formed of magic began to rain down. Jin, Belize, and Linpa swung their swords to deflect the falling spears.
"I wonder if Beradin Ziffle will still think of me the same way after I kill all of you."
At that moment, Jin felt a slight tremor in Elona's gaze.
'If anything in our conversation just now affected her, it means that the brainwashing applied to Lady Elona is not perfect.'
The spears raining from the cubes were strong, but not as powerful as expected. From the start, Elona had no intention of seriously fighting Jin's group.
Her goal was to destroy the Laprarosa passage, so it was better to ignore Jin's group as much as possible.
In a flash, using her magic, Elona flew past the group and advanced ahead. The cubes remained in place, attacking the three, preventing them from pursuing her at the same speed.
The enemy troops immediately sensed the situation and began firing mainly at Jin and the duo. Thanks to this, Elona could easily distance herself from the three.
But Jin had no intention of letting Elona go.
"There are things in this world that can't be broken by power alone, Lady Elona. Laprarosa is one of them, as is the true self you've forgotten."
The voice filled with the energy of a star piercer penetrated the gunfire and reached Elona's ears. Elona turned back for a moment upon hearing his voice.

Both her rationality and inner feelings were in turmoil. Her rationality was confused as Jin didn't come to guard the Laprarosa passage, while her inner self was torn between wanting to hear his words again and wanting to deny them.
However, Elona did not approach Jin's group again. She silently started pouring magic towards the Laprarosa passage.
Jin's group began moving out of the cubes left by Elona, heading towards the outskirts of the desert's center.
They had to show the enemies that there was no need to guard Laprarosa diligently. If they tried to block it at all costs, the enemies would send more troops.
"...Let's go back, brothers. From now on, we can only trust the rest to Ban and the others until we can throw the liberation device inside."
